## Highlights

- One-shot advice can now skip locally trivial plan/final work before vendor probes, consent, or
  repository snapshots. Task-only context no longer snapshots the worktree or performs local
  file-and-line triage.
- Councils have one bounded whole-council deadline through `--total-timeout-seconds`. Members that
  cannot start before the deadline are reported separately, and partial councils use exit code 3.
- Human review output keeps locally rejected high/critical findings visible for manual inspection
  and describes structural triage as locally checkable rather than semantically supported.
- Managed campaign verification protects the complete project `.weightclass` verifier zone.
  `doctor` checks every selected workflow route and reports whether the installed managed wrapper
  matches the current package.
- New campaign gates use population rule v2, excluding infrastructure failures from every
  attempted route. Historical sealed v1 gates retain their original population definition.
- Advisory Skill onboarding generation 17 shortens the primary workflow, moves campaign detail to
  its reference, reports customized installs under `conflicts`, and adds an automated release gate
  preventing omission of the previous exact Skill bundle from the upgrade ledger.

## Core routing and diagnostics

- Schema-2 fingerprint mismatches that cannot match any reviewed route now fail before task input.
- Argv-delivered tasks reject NUL before interactive confirmation, and platforms without
  `os.ctermid` fail closed instead of raising an unexpected attribute error.
- A schema-3 aggregate usage-store failure after child completion now reports the child's bounded
  return code so callers can distinguish child and accounting outcomes.
- Legacy escalation suggestions explicitly report that schema-3 rework accounting is unsupported
  instead of recommending an unusable `--usage-rework` flow.

## Compatibility and safety

This release intentionally changes one-shot receipt schema version 1 to 2, changes a partial
council's exit status from 2 to 3, and removes the ineffective `wclass-advisory ask --role` option.
Consumers must use the receipt's `complete` and per-member `status` fields rather than treating all
non-zero exits alike. Task-only receipts report `worktree_checked:false`,
`worktree_unchanged:null`, no requested repository access, and no local triage.

Existing schema-1 managed gate populations remain valid and are evaluated with their sealed v1
rule. Existing managed roots whose copied verifier wrapper predates this package remain preserved,
but `doctor` marks dispatch not ready until the owner explicitly reruns `init` to install the
current package wrapper. Candidate-controlled dependencies outside the protected `.weightclass`
zone remain outside the verifier guarantee.

Four scrubbed GLM review packets covered core routing, one-shot behavior, managed campaigns, and
Skill/release operations (172,667, 94,999, 118,240, and 81,920 bytes; SHA-256 prefixes
`6bdb523325f7`, `6fd9bf00607c`, `517eda63f090`, and `326d77c9a47c`). Provider output was treated as
untrusted and every retained finding was reproduced or validated locally before implementation.

Local validation passed 1,573 tests with 35 skips, Ruff check and format-check over 248 files,
strict mypy over 204 source files, compileall, and whitespace checks. Extracted-sdist isolation
passed 1,566 tests with 80 skips. Implementation PR #173 passed all eight Linux Python 3.10-3.14,
macOS Python 3.10/3.14, lint, type, build, and distribution checks.

## Installation

```sh
uv tool install --upgrade "weightclass==0.29.0"
brew upgrade ictechgy/tap/weightclass
```
